flags.why: This word belongs to formal administrative language and needs a register warning ([dictionary](https://dictionary.zim.vn/viet-anh/chuc-trach-tieng-anh-la-gi)).
The entry omits the common conversational meaning of holding something back or delaying its return or resolution ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/om)).
flags.fix: Add: verb [colloquial] | to hold onto something unduly; to delay dealing with something; ex: Anh ấy cứ om tiền mãi không trả. = He keeps holding onto the money without paying it back.

flags.why: Supporting or lifting something from underneath is a current meaning of bợ, so archaic is misleading ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-b%E1%BB%A3)).
Song phương belongs to formal diplomatic and institutional language and needs a register warning ([dictionary](https://dictionary.zim.vn/viet-anh/song-phuong-tieng-anh-la-gi)).
